title: Do Chatbots Walk the Talk of Responsible AI?
reasoning: The paper's primary objective is to evaluate and benchmark the 'Responsible AI' practices of four major LLM chatbots (GPT-4o, Grok 3, Gemini 2.5, and DeepSeek V3). This evaluation specifically centers on ethical components, including human rights, democratic values, fairness, and accountability, which are the core focus of the study rather than just a secondary consideration.
